# Ranked beer destinations — Manchester, Liverpool and the surrounding area

[Home](../README.md) · [Dated itinerary](five-day-plan.md) · [Cider guide](real-cider.md) · [All venue profiles](catalogue.md)

**158 ranked choices, strongest overall first.** This is an *editorial relevance ranking*, not a firsthand tasting inspection, star rating or a statement of which tap is serving the best-conditioned pint today. It reflects evidenced real-ale/cider depth, distinctive interiors and atmosphere, beer experiences, 2026 awards, food and visit value. A highly ranked excursion outside the two cities may be a poor *time fit* for these particular 9–14 November dates. Use the [dated schedule](five-day-plan.md) to make a realistic selection.

## The fifteen highest priorities

| Rank | Venue | Why it earns a top slot |
| ---: | --- | --- |
| 1 | [Marble Arch](venues/marble-arch.md) | Exceptional Marble cask, real cider, Victorian tiling and proper food; Tuesday closure makes timing essential. |
| 2 | [Ship & Mitre](venues/ship-and-mitre.md) | Liverpool’s most complete breadth of real ale, world beer, cider and a traditional pub atmosphere, with food. |
| 3 | [Petersgate Tap](venues/petersgate-tap-stockport.md) | Probably the best compact Stockport blend of changing cask and serious real cider/perry. |
| 4 | [Fox & Pine](venues/fox-and-pine-oldham.md) | Top-tier dark cask selection and multiple real ciders/perries; Oldham’s 2026 branch winner. |
| 5 | [That Beer Place](venues/that-beer-place-chester.md) | Chester’s standout specialist cider/perry collection and interesting beer; a full excursion. |
| 6 | [Turks Head](venues/turks-head-st-helens.md) | St Helens landmark with cask and cider depth, food and national 2026 POTY-finalist recognition. |
| 7 | [Roscoe Head](venues/roscoe-head.md) | Small-room independent cask ideal; the ultimate Liverpool traditional-local anchor. |
| 8 | [Lion Tavern](venues/lion-tavern.md) | Original historic pub detail, cask, cider and exceptional atmosphere in a small city-centre space. |
| 9 | [Crown & Kettle](venues/crown-and-kettle.md) | An extraordinary old ceiling with changing cask and documented real cider. |
| 10 | [Cafe Beermoth](venues/cafe-beermoth.md) | 2026 Central Manchester Pub of the Year; broad cask and remarkable bottle selection. |
| 11 | [Philharmonic Dining Rooms](venues/philharmonic-dining-rooms.md) | Liverpool’s most spectacular heritage room, with cask and meals; less cider-led. |
| 12 | [Stalybridge Buffet Bar](venues/stalybridge-buffet-bar.md) | Victorian railway buffet, a genuine one-off pub experience, cask and cider. |
| 13 | [The Coop](venues/coop-crosby.md) | 2026 Liverpool branch Pub of the Year; serious changing cask and cider in Crosby. |
| 14 | [Arden Arms](venues/arden-arms-stockport.md) | A model of Stockport old pub rooms, Robinsons cask and meals; cider not established. |
| 15 | [Our Gracie’s](venues/our-gracies-rochdale.md) | 2026 Rochdale cider winner, a highly worthwhile specialist cider/perry and cask detour. |

## How to use these positions

The top section is judgment-led rather than an arithmetic league table. For the remaining records, the stable order reflects existing essential/high/specialist curation, evidence of cask and real cider, specialist cider/perry, heritage, dark styles, meal options and practical travel. Scores are intentionally *not published* because their numerical precision would be misleading. A real-cider badge alone does not prove a large cider list, and some documented cider is occasional.

For **Manchester days**, put Marble Arch, Crown & Kettle, Café Beermoth, Smithfield, City Arms, Peveril and Britons Protection ahead of another generic taproom. For **Liverpool days**, put Ship & Mitre, Roscoe Head, Lion, Philharmonic, Peter Kavanagh’s and The Vines ahead of a broad keg-only tasting. For **excursions**, choose **Stockport** for variety and easy integration, or **Oldham, St Helens, Chester, Crosby and Rochdale** when their particular cider/ale experience warrants the train time.

Read the [flight-aware schedule](five-day-plan.md), [November events](november-events.md), and [source methodology](methodology.md) before choosing. Times, beer lineups and the identity of qualifying cider are not guaranteed by this static ranking.
